sources.snippet: GLM 5.3 See GLM 5.3 in action: demonstration videos Tested with a M3 Ultra using Inferencer app Text Inference: ~15.8 tokens/s @ 1000 tokens ~428.6 GiB Q4-INF uses the data-agnostic INF method tuned to yield maximum general accuracy within a 512 GiB memory budget. Due to system memory and time constraints, the figures shown below are from the conversion of GLM 5.1.
